claims.assertion: Swaruu de Erra says DNA misaligned with an adma imprint becomes unstable; frequency containers align captured admas with altered bodies.
claims.speaker: Swaruu de Erra

claims.assertion: She describes AI clones with programmed identities and limited interactivity, coordinated centrally.
claims.speaker: Swaruu de Erra

claims.assertion: She names Red Queen as an AI controlling clones, drones, vehicles, and connected devices through global nodes.
claims.speaker: Swaruu de Erra
claims.qualifiers: Independent nodes answer to a central system.

claims.assertion: Clone stability varies with formation: cheaper models last weeks; 3–5-month models may reach original lifespans.
claims.speaker: Swaruu de Erra
claims.qualifiers: Longer formation costs more and increases stability.
